name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018: Collaborative Network Intrusion Detection Dataset
description: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 is a large-scale cybersecurity network intrusion detection dataset generated collaboratively by the Communications Security Establishment (CSE) and the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC) at the University of New Brunswick. Captured on an AWS cloud testbed comprising 500 victim machines and 50 attacking machines over 10 days, it captures realistic benign background traffic alongside diverse attack scenarios: Brute Force, Heartbleed, Botnet, DoS, DDoS, Web Attacks, and Network Infiltration. Provided as raw PCAP captures (~400 GB) and extracted CICFlowMeter bidirectional network flow CSVs (~16 million flow records with 80 statistical features).
